purpose: prevent recent-slice amnesia and force A+B+C reconstruction before scope/progress/release decisions

immutable_history_anchors.rule: Historical A is never deleted or silently narrowed by a recent implementation slice.

full_completion_contract.rule: Never quote completion from REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY alone.

anti_amnesia_invariants: A+B+C is loaded before any percentage-complete answer.
Original major modules remain visible even when gated/not started.
A recent release traceability table cannot redefine the product ambition.
Every field correction is appended to C and linked to a durable test/policy when practical.
Every new researched capability added to B gets explicit provenance and a release/safety gate.
The installed field baseline and active development successor are distinct.
No micro-beta chain is created merely to show progress.
Gmail END provider ACK and durable END_ACK precede final app closeout.
B depth is loaded separately from the macro ledger so research can deepen requirements without gaming the completion denominator.
ConnectivityDiagnostics eligibility is capability-gated; Lite Observer never assumes callback delivery from registration success.
Canonical context pack is derived and must match scorecard/anchors; it never replaces chronicle/history.
Exactly one KINLINK communication watchdog policy is canonical; automation is a safety net, not a substitute for primary START/END protocol.
Android 17 LAN permission is feature-scoped: never add a blanket startup permission prompt merely because targetSdk is 37.
B-depth growth must update the integrity verifier and context pack without changing the 80-macro denominator automatically.
Progress is organized by integrated waves; internal CI iterations must never be confused with user-facing micro-beta delivery.
Canonical A+B+C and communication-policy files are Git-blob pinned by RESUME_CAPSULE; partial sync fails CI instead of silently degrading context.
Volatile state is never frozen into the capsule as truth; takeover must read it fresh.
Cold-takeover CI must prove project_state, BUILD_STATUS, NEXT_UNCOMMITTED_ACTION and current communication ledger tell the same live story.
Per-SIM Mobile Vault truth must never be inferred from aggregate mobile counters; B91-B100 preserve attribution, permission and restart semantics.
Communication is milestone-based with no fixed tranche duration; age alone cannot force END.
Gmail START/END must be human explanatory and substantively consistent with chat.
The current 0.8 Lite field candidate may be delivered before advanced W4/W5, while those major A+B+C gaps remain explicitly visible.
